info.name: COMPLETE STAYHERE V1 POSTMAN COLLECTION
info.description:
Every HTTP-triggered Azure Function across all 8 StayHere backend services, pointed at local `func start` hosts. Organized one top-level folder per function app, in the exact order you'd typically exercise them end-to-end (Auth -> Customer -> Property -> Owner -> Static Data -> AI Agent -> Payments -> Logging).

## Getting started
1. Start each function app locally on its configured port (see each folder's description for the port and its `host.json`/`local.settings.json`).
2. Run **Auth Service > Login (request OTP)** then **Verify OTP** - this auto-saves a real JWT into the `authToken` collection variable via a Tests script, which every other request inherits as its Bearer token.
3. Most services also have `SKIP_AUTH=true` set locally: with no token at all you're treated as an auto-Admin dev principal, and the collection also sends `X-User-Id: {{userId}}` on every request (via the collection-level Pre-request Script) so endpoints that resolve identity from that header behave as a specific real test user instead.

## Test data
All IDs in the collection variables (`listingId`, `customerId`, `applicationId`, `ownerId`, etc.) are REAL rows pulled directly from the local dev database at the time this collection was built, not placeholders - every GET-by-id request in this collection is expected to return 200 out of the box. If you reset/reseed the database, re-pull fresh IDs and update the collection variables.

## Route prefix & ports
Every service's `host.json` sets `"routePrefix": "api"` (the Azure Functions default), and each base-URL variable already includes `/api` - so paths below are appended directly, e.g. `{{propertyBaseUrl}}/listings/{{listingId}}` resolves to `http://localhost:7072/api/listings/<guid>`.

exec: // Convenience for services with SKIP_AUTH=true locally: lets an endpoint that resolves
// identity from X-User-Id behave as a specific real seeded user, without needing a live
// JWT for quick smoke-testing. Harmless to send alongside a real Bearer token too - it's
// only consulted as a fallback when no valid token is present.

item.name: 1. Auth Service (:7071)

request.description: Creates a bare user account only (no role/profile yet). Follow with POST /auth/onboard, or use /auth/register to do both in one call.
Provide email OR phoneNumber (not both) to request an OTP. Provide entraToken instead for SSO login. Check the local log file / LoggingService for the generated OTP in dev.
Returns { token, user } on success - the Tests script below auto-saves the token into the 'authToken' collection variable so every other request picks it up immediately.
Any authenticated user (bare [Authorize], no specific role required).
Combines Signup + Onboard in a single call - the quickest way to create a fully-usable test account. Role must be Tenant | PropertyOwner | Admin.

item.description: JWT auth: Bearer token issued by /auth/verifyotp or /auth/register. Header name/claims are standard (Authorization: Bearer <token>). This service does NOT have SKIP_AUTH enabled locally, so a real token (or the dev fallback described in AuthenticationMiddleware) is required for every [Authorize] endpoint below.

item.name: 2. Customer Service (:7073)

request.description: Identity resolved from the caller's JWT (or X-User-Id header when SKIP_AUTH=true) - listingId/customerId are never read from body/route for this endpoint.

item.description: SKIP_AUTH=true is set locally for this service: with no Authorization header, requests fall back to a dev Admin principal. Add 'X-User-Id: {{userId}}' as a header to simulate a specific signed-in customer (used by saved-listings for identity).

request.description: Idempotent: returns the existing active application for this listing+customer if one already exists, instead of creating a duplicate (enforced by a DB partial unique index too). Starts at status=PendingApproval.
Requires current status=PendingApproval. Approved -> DocumentsPending. Rejected -> Rejected (include a 'reason').
Requires current status=DocumentsPending (reached after pre-screen approval). Transitions to UnderReview.
Requires current status=UnderReview. Use decision=Rejected + a 'reason' field to reject instead.
Requires current status=Approved.
Requires application status=Active (payment already confirmed).

listingId must reference a ShortStay-type listing. bookingFeeAmount (half of one night's price) is computed server-side - never trust a client-supplied amount. Returns 409 if the date range overlaps an existing Confirmed/fresh-PendingPayment booking.

documentType must be exactly one of IdFront | IdBack | Selfie. Only allowed once the booking's payment is Confirmed (409 otherwise) - ID verification happens AFTER the booking fee is paid, not before.
Identity (who's asking) is resolved from the caller's JWT/X-User-Id header, never from the body.

item.name: 6. AI Agent Service - Sage (:7076)

request.description: Caller identity comes from the JWT/X-User-Id header, not the body. Omit conversationId to start a new conversation.
Content-Type must be multipart/form-data with a single part named 'image'. Attach a floor plan image file in the Body tab before sending. Does not persist anything - analysis only.

item.description: SKIP_AUTH=true locally. Most endpoints need an authenticated Tenant/PropertyOwner/PropertyManager/Admin; listings search and health are public.

item.name: 7. Payments Service - M-Pesa (:7077)
Initiate STK Push (Tenant Application - Security Deposit)

request.description: Exactly ONE of applicationId / shortStayBookingId must be set per request - this variant uses applicationId. amount falls back to the listing's PropertyTerms.SecurityDeposit if omitted/0. Only allowed once the application has accepted terms (status TermsAccepted or PaymentPending).

Exactly ONE of applicationId / shortStayBookingId must be set per request - this variant uses shortStayBookingId. amount falls back to booking.BookingFeeAmount if omitted/0. Only allowed while the booking is still PendingPayment.

item.name: STK Push Callback (Safaricom webhook - do not call directly)

request.description: Safaricom calls this URL automatically after the customer accepts/dismisses the STK prompt - only useful to call manually here to simulate that callback in local testing.

Callable by Tenant/PropertyOwner/PropertyManager/Admin (not Admin-only). Actively asks Safaricom for the transaction's real status and self-heals the local RentalPayment + linked ShortStayBooking/TenantApplication if the STK callback webhook never arrived - this is what the client's 'I've already paid - Check Status' button calls, and what the automatic polling loop calls every ~4s while waiting.

item.name: C2B Validate (Safaricom webhook - do not call directly)

request.description: Safaricom calls this before processing a PayBill/Buy Goods payment to ask whether to accept it.

item.name: C2B Confirm (Safaricom webhook - do not call directly)

request.description: Safaricom calls this after a C2B payment completes successfully.

item.description: SKIP_AUTH=true locally. The 3 webhook endpoints (STK callback, C2B validate/confirm) are called by Safaricom itself in real usage - included here with realistic sample payloads purely so you can simulate them locally without waiting for a real M-Pesa sandbox round-trip.

item.name: 8. Logging Service (:7078)

request.description: date is required (format yyyy-MM-dd). Non-Admin callers may only read logs for their own customerId.

item.description: No SKIP_AUTH setting present for this service - ReadLog requires a real caller identity (Bearer token or X-User-Id). WriteLog is AllowAnonymous.
